title: Demo Project — Web OS Showcase
highlights: Zero-code project onboarding from a single folder
Verifies gallery ordering, README rendering & PDF preview
Ships a real case-study.pdf opened via native Preview
shortDesc: A test project validating the filesystem-driven content pipeline.
fullDesc: A throwaway project folder used to prove the core promise of this portfolio: adding a project requires zero code changes — just drop a folder with data.json, a README, and optional images + a case-study PDF. This project exercises gallery ordering (numeric prefixes), README rendering, and real-PDF preview in one shot.
